marker_critique.assessment: Grounds must be recoverable, but immutable creation-time grounds are not the whole evolving evidence history, and origin is not justification. Mandatory nonempty basis for every record risks fabricated grounds and blocks genuine root inputs.
marker_critique.invariant: Keep recorded grounds immutable; later evidence/corrections append separately with provenance. Distinguish user requirement/observation/hypothesis and explicit missing grounds; do not silently choose mandatory policy.

marker_critique.assessment: Fits confirmed nested immutable versions, but logical claim identity and record/version identity must be separated. Common logical ID plus distinct immutable version/record ID can preserve immutability; the orchestrator's blanket claim to the contrary is unsupported. tree_id/record_id/parent_ref are not approved field names.
marker_critique.invariant: Parent above; new versions nested within the same logical claim; original bytes unchanged. A record address must identify one immutable version; existing IDs stay unchanged. AA11/АА11 are literal discussion examples, not AA001 task IDs.

marker_critique.proposal: typed link event, target pin, note, optional keywords
marker_critique.assessment: Current link is only url+locator. Typed relations need direction, endpoint type, role, vocabulary version and bounded structured validation; a closed vocabulary is necessary but not sufficient. A semantic supports edge is not a proof. Branch dependency pins are useful precedent, not implemented per-edge version pins.
marker_critique.invariant: No hidden target metadata; updates append instead of altering existing links. Similarity suggestions cannot become admitted semantic edges automatically.

marker_critique.assessment: Do not conflate candidate review, actual admission, current validity, branch convergence, delivery and owner acceptance. A review/converge flag alone cannot show who accepted which content under which dependencies. Demo review is explicitly simulated.
marker_critique.invariant: Derive state from admitted version plus exact review/policy/dependency snapshot; preserve previous state and expose stale/unknown rather than falsely current. Do not label proposed fields implemented.

marker_critique.assessment: Derived does not mean safe or necessarily never persisted: materialized indexes/caches may be appropriate, but not authoritative. Grants must constrain candidates and accessible edges before counts, scoring, sorting, top-k, pagination and cache lookup/output. Post-filtering leaks through ranks/counts/deltas.
marker_critique.invariant: Authorized views must not reveal hidden branch existence/IDs/counts/revisions or changes. H-LINK is a known gap, not a new reproduced defect.

marker_critique.assessment: Subblock should be an append-only event/view usable for all content types, not a mutable list inserted into the original claim. local/external is not trust, permission or immutability. An external URL without snapshot leaves remote content unpinned but does not mutate the immutable recorded URL; a digest without retained bytes is not reproducibility. Local files can change too.
marker_critique.invariant: Retain exact recorded locator and evidence revision/bytes where permitted; re-fetch and source correction are new events. Avoid secrets, arbitrary path/URL access and unintended fetches.

marker_critique.assessment: Separate immutable origin from applicability and from access grants. Current projection has applicable_branches, but no per-branch since-revision in that list; it must not be described as complete membership/history or grant. Historical views must not silently use current branch eligibility/pins.
marker_critique.invariant: Origin never rewritten; explicit applicability events do not transfer authority, rewrite admission dependencies or automatically move the accepted leaf of another branch.

Events and nested versions are distinct immutable records in one derived tree. Stable deterministic order needs branch revision plus an event-order/tie-breaker, not client timestamps alone. Last means latest independently admitted applicable version under an explicit fork policy, not latest candidate globally.

Keyword placement remains needs_user: the answer да to an или question selects neither claim nor edge nor both. Compare choices without stopping independent work; do not ask again about the confirmed nested tree.

New fields are not a harmless decoration: validate emits UNKNOWN_FIELD (required=false still an error); submit rejects any error. Update schema/admission/storage/DTO/projections together only in a future authorized worker scope.
